input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: The cap and the consequential-damages exclusion protect Licensor only, and the cap is one half of amounts we have actually paid — well below 6 months' fees and effectively illusory early in the term. Article II compounds this: we "hereby assume all liabilities and risks associated with the use of the system" and Licensor is excluded from all IP-infringement liability. There are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security, indemnities, fraud or IP infringement. This is at the playbook walk-away line; redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1M with standard Excluded Claims.

input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Article XII is a broad one-way Licensee indemnity (covering even the mere exercise of our licence rights and the conduct of our business) with no Licensor indemnity at all; Article XIII goes further and excludes Licensor from any liability for third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Platform. That is the playbook walk-away. Redline inserts a Licensor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with standard procedure.

input.quote: 1.5 "FIELD OF USE" means, and is limited to, the utilization of the Licensed Technology by the Licensee for the exclusive purpose of fulfilling Spot FX transactions by transmitting market data and orders.
input.rationale: No express non-compete binds us, but the Field of Use construct plus the Article II restrictions and the change-of-control provision (consent deemed reasonably withheld where our acquirer competes with Licensor) operate as an indirect field-of-use restraint on our business and our M&A options. We accept restrictions on use of the Platform itself, so the minimal fix is a confirmation that nothing restricts us from operating our business or building/procuring alternative FX technology; the competitor-acquirer veto is addressed under ASSIGN.
